reuseMatrix: tops {tank, tee, sweater, V1, V2} × bottoms {shorts, V3, V4, V5} × shoes {sneakers, V6} = 40 outfits, 30 of them with at least one new item; every new item meets at least two other new or existing items at its seam
successCriteria: each item: technically OK (pipeline d225) AND seam contract complied
every outfit of compliant items: outfit check OK
no new open finding at a seam the contract covers
a failure is classified: the model did not follow the instruction (generation), the rule was not measured right (tool) or the contract is incomplete (contract)
